memory_candidates: lake-build-guard.sh shares an already-completed build's result: a scoped `-- build Module` run immediately followed by an unscoped `-- build` can return the SCOPED result with the scoped job count. Pass --no-share when the unscoped full-project build is the verification evidence.

A wait loop written as `until ! pgrep -f "lake-build-guard.sh build"; do sleep; done` never terminates: the waiting shell's own command line contains the pattern, so pgrep matches itself. Wait on the build PID with `kill -0 $pid` instead.
